description:
A three-bedroom villa on Jalan Danau Tamblingan — the street that runs the length of Sanur — three minutes on foot from the ocean and the beachfront promenade. Two floors and 200 m² of house on a 300 m² plot, renovated top to bottom in 2026 and sold fully furnished.

The ground floor is modern and open: a living room and a dining table under lit ceilings, timber doors onto the pool terrace, and a closed kitchen in white and walnut with quartz worktops, an induction hob and an oven. Behind it sit a guest toilet with the laundry, a walk-in wardrobe and one more room the owners left empty — an office, a gym or a fourth bedroom, with its own glazed doors onto a planted courtyard. A travertine stair with lit treads and a glass balustrade leads upstairs.

Above, the house keeps its Balinese character: open rafters under alang-alang thatch, stone-clad walls behind the beds, travertine floors and carved timber balconies over the garden. Three bedrooms share two marble bathrooms with double vanities and walk-in showers, one of them with a free-standing tub at the window.

Outside, a nine-metre pool in green stone mosaic runs the length of the lawn under old frangipani trees, with sun loungers on the terrace and a lounge corner at the far end. The villa stands in a managed complex with its own security; the ocean shows from the upper floor and the mountains inland on a clear day.
